policy: Split a corrected CNS5 record that combines two published components only when the frozen MSC hierarchy, an ORB6 orbit or a primary paper resolves the pair. The first member keeps the source ID and its own aliases; aliases naming the second member move to it. The unresolved parent stays a scoped retained source. Shared position and bulk motion are approximate; no individual orbital phase or velocity is inferred.

notSplit.reason: MSC 02482+2704 Aa,Ab is a 16.3-year single-lined spectroscopic/astrometric pair (SB9 2276) whose companion has only a minimum mass of 0.18 Msun and no spectrum. An unclassified companion is not authored.
MSC 07291+3147 B is a V=12.5 star 3.4 arcsec away, physical only by hypothetical parallax (Ch), with no spectrum or orbit. The record's light and astrometry are those of A.

notSplit.record: cns5-2108 CU Cnc (CNS5 AE); cns5-2107/cns5-2106 CV Cnc A/B (CNS5 BC/D)
notSplit.reason: Legacy Gliese labels do not match the MSC hierarchy: CU Cnc holds the eclipsing Aa1/Aa2 pair plus the 1-arcsec Ab, and CV Cnc A/B are already separate records for WDS Ba/Bb. MSC notes conflicting assignments of DEL 1 and BEU 12. A three-member relabeling needs its own review.

systems.sourceScope: GJ 153 BC (G 221-24A) catalog source; unresolved B+C contributions; not an individual B/C measurement
systems.note: MSC 03480+6840 and ORB6 KUI 13BC resolve the CNS5 BC record into a 0.68-arcsec visual pair with a 40.9-year orbit. MSC lists the composite M2V+K6V and inconsistent component V values (11.18 each in sys.tsv, combined 10.43 or 11.40), so no individual magnitude or spectral type is adopted.
